description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Montana Code Annotated — Montana state law — by citation. "MCA 45-5-102" is deliberate homicide. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does MCA 45-5-102 say" or to check a Montana statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "45-5-102" (deliberate homicide) or "61-8-401" (DUI). Title-chapter-section.

name: mt_code_section
title: Mt Code Section
